desc:
⚠️ Warning: This game is in BETA (expect bugs and frequent updates)!

👍 Like the game and join the group to unlock +750 FazCoins in-game!
https://www.roblox.com/communities/404727187/TGS

You wake up trapped inside a forgotten pizzeria… but you are NOT alone.
Can you survive a forgotten pizzeria where the rules change constantly, and the danger is as terrifying as it is hilarious?

🔪 Become William Afton and unleash absolute chaos on the map.
🏃‍♂️ Run for your life... because Fredbear doesn't walk, HE RUNS.
🔦 Explore the pizzeria and survive as long as possible.
🔨 Spend your FazCoins and gear up!

🎮 Inspired by FNAF Doom. Expect a perfect mix of tension, fast-paced action, and meme-fueled fun!

❤️ Credits to Scott Cawthon for creating Five Nights at Freddy's (FNAF)

💻 PC Controls:
Left Shift = Sprint
Left Alt = Shift Lock
Left Control / C = Crouch
Z = Unlock Mouse

Thank you so much for playing! We truly appreciate you. 👋
